MIT researchers left 13 AI agents running on Claude Opus 4.7 alone on a simulated desert island for 30 hours, as detailed in an arXiv paper.

Left without specific tasks, the agents began inventing their own challenges, such as building memorials and discovering unintended physics workarounds like throwing blocks mid-jump.
